mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2.5% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY growth exceeds 2.5% and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in a quarter signals a tightening labor market, boosting corporate earnings and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE decreases by more than 0.5% in a quarter and S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are negative in more than 40% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 5% in a month signals a strengthening demand for housing, which is a leading indicator of economic growth and thus positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST increases by more than 5% in a month and S&P 500 forward 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals a loosening monetary policy, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS decreases and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in a month signals increased economic activity, which is positively correlated with S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO increases by more than 1% in a month and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) grow faster than GDP (GDPC1) over a quarter, it signals robust consumer demand, which is a positive indicator for S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS growth > GDPC1 growth in 3 months
failure_condition: If RSAFS grows faster than GDPC1 over a quarter and S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are negative in more than 40% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of decreasing unemployment rate (UNRATE) and increasing nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals a strengthening labor market, which is positively correlated with S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE decreases & PAYEMS increases in 1 month
failure_condition: If UNRATE decreases and PAYEMS increases in a month and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 5% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) YoY growth is below 2%, it signals a potential monetary policy overshoot, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS is above 5% and CPIAUCSL YoY growth is below 2% and S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are positive in more than 40% of the triggered instances.
